description.zh: 3 轴与 3+2 定轴（第四轴/摇篮）CNC 铣削 CAM：用 FreeCAD 的 CAM 工作台把 STEP 零件变成加工中心/雕刻机 G-code（面铣、自适应开粗与精加工、钻孔、外轮廓、3D 曲面），按控制器后处理（GRBL、LinuxCNC、Fanuc、Mach3/4 等），并检查毛坯/行程/刃长，生成预览图、加工单和可在 FreeCAD 里仿真的工程文件。首次使用自动下载安装 FreeCAD（约数百 MB）。先用 apply_skill 应用 cam 技能。经用户确认后执行，从不连接机床。
description.en: 3-axis and 3+2 indexed (4th-axis / trunnion) CNC milling CAM: turn a STEP part into machining-center / router G-code with FreeCAD's CAM workbench (facing, adaptive roughing and finishing, drilling, outline profile, 3D surface), posted for the controller (GRBL, LinuxCNC, Fanuc, Mach3/4 and more), with stock / travel / flute-length checks, a preview, a setup sheet and a FreeCAD project to simulate. Installs FreeCAD on first use (several hundred MB). Apply the cam skill first with apply_skill. Runs after user confirmation and never connects to a machine.

input.description: 工作目录内的 STEP 零件（.step/.stp），Z 向上为加工方向（定轴加工时各工位方向由 setups 给出），按零件实际尺寸 mm

output.description: 输出程序路径，默认与输入同名 .nc；GRBL 每把刀一个文件（_01_T1.nc…）；旁边还会写 .preview.svg、.setup.md 加工单和 .FCStd FreeCAD 工程

machine.description: 机床：controller（grbl / linuxcnc / fanuc / mach3 / mach4 / centroid / uccnc / heidenhain）、travel [x,y,z] 行程 mm、max_rpm、max_feed、rapid、tool_change（manual 则按刀分文件）、name；多工位定轴加工还需 rotary {axes: A / B / AC / BC, mode: table（默认，输出 A/B/C 旋转）或 tilted_plane（仅 Fanuc，G68.2）, limits {"A": [最小, 最大]}, signs {"A": -1 方向相反时}, center_height 摇篮转台面到倾斜轴的距离, retract 旋转前抬刀行（默认 G53 G0 Z0）}

machine_file.description: 工作目录内的 JSON 文件，内容同 machine（已保存的机床配置）

job.description: 本次加工：stock {xy 四周余量, top 顶面余量, bottom 底部多出的料} mm（必填）、tools（必填）、operations（可省，默认：面铣→自适应开粗→钻孔→自适应精加工→球头曲面精加工；每项 {type: face/rough/finish/profile/drill/surface/waterline, tool, stepover %, stepdown, stock_to_leave}）、finish_allowance 精加工余量（默认 0.3）、skin 底部无余量时保留的连皮（默认 0.3）、safe_height、clearance_height、allow_below_stock。刀具列表，每把：number 刀号、type（endmill 平底 / ballend 球头 / bullnose 圆鼻 / drill 钻头 / chamfer 倒角 / v-bit）、diameter 直径 mm、rpm 转速、feed 进给 mm/min、plunge 下刀 mm/min、stepdown 每层切深 mm（钻头不用），可选 flute_length 刃长、length 伸出长、flutes 刃数、peck 啄钻深度、tip_angle 钻尖角、name。转速、进给、切深必须来自用户，不得猜测。3+2 定轴：setups 列表，每个工位 {name, direction 刀具来向（+X/-X/+Y/-Y/+Z/-Z 或 [x,y,z]）或直接给 A/B/C 角度, operations（可省）, floor 最深 Z（A/B 轴默认 0，即旋转轴线）}；hold 卡盘夹持的料头长度 mm（A/B 轴）；offset [x,y,z] 零件相对旋转中心的偏移。工件零点为旋转中心，每个工位一个程序

job_file.description: 工作目录内的 JSON 文件，内容同 job

input.description: a STEP part in the workspace (.step/.stp), machined from +Z (or from each setup's direction with setups), real size in mm

output.description: program path, default the input name with .nc; GRBL gets one file per tool (_01_T1.nc…); a .preview.svg, a .setup.md setup sheet and a .FCStd FreeCAD project are written next to it

machine.description: machine: controller (grbl / linuxcnc / fanuc / mach3 / mach4 / centroid / uccnc / heidenhain), travel [x,y,z] mm, max_rpm, max_feed, rapid, tool_change (manual splits files per tool), name; indexed setups also need rotary {axes: A / B / AC / BC, mode: table (default, writes A/B/C moves) or tilted_plane (Fanuc only, G68.2), limits {"A": [min, max]}, signs {"A": -1 when it turns the other way}, center_height from the trunnion table top to the tilt axis, retract line before each rotation (default G53 G0 Z0)}

machine_file.description: a JSON file in the workspace holding the machine object (a saved machine profile)

job.description: this job: stock {xy margin each side, top, bottom extra material} mm (required), tools (required), operations (optional; default face → adaptive rough → drill → adaptive finish → ball-end surface; each {type: face/rough/finish/profile/drill/surface/waterline, tool, stepover %, stepdown, stock_to_leave}), finish_allowance (default 0.3), skin left when there is no bottom stock (default 0.3), safe_height, clearance_height, allow_below_stock. tools, each: number, type (endmill / ballend / bullnose / drill / chamfer / v-bit), diameter mm, rpm, feed mm/min, plunge mm/min, stepdown mm per pass (not for drills); optional flute_length, length (stick-out), flutes, peck, tip_angle, name. Speeds, feeds and depths of cut must come from the user, never guessed. 3+2 indexed: setups, a list of {name, direction the tool comes from (+X/-X/+Y/-Y/+Z/-Z or [x,y,z]) or the A/B/C angles, operations (optional), floor deepest Z (A/B axes default 0, the rotary axis)}; hold, the stub length held in the chuck in mm (A/B axes); offset [x,y,z] of the part from the rotary centre. Work zero is the rotary centre; one program per setup

job_file.description: a JSON file in the workspace holding the job object
